theater: 秦嶺漢中、陰平谷道與祁山

battle.name: 漢中之戰
battle.theater: 秦嶺漢中、陰平谷道與祁山
battle.brief: 元嘉十年（433），赫連夏主赫連定出長安西走隴西，為吐谷渾擒送平城，關中遂定；漢中、祁山的仇池氐人政權自此被魏軍直接威脅，谷道拉鋸隨即展開。卡面的希臘重步兵並未上陣，它代表重裝步兵以盾遮蔽、互相掩護的典範。

kit.name: 希臘重步兵
kit.history: 方陣的重心不是個人，是互相遮蔽。盾牌接在一起時，一支軍隊的正面比一個人結實。

countries: 交戰一方是北魏。太武帝拓跋燾以平城為都，公元433年時河西新附、關中殘局未定，朝廷以尚書令崔浩參贊軍務，諸王拓跋晃坐鎮涼州，拓跋部騎兵仍是國家的骨幹，漢人將領與氐、羯舊部共同分掌兵柄；對西面又以羈縻與撫賞拉攏吐谷渾。另一方是盤據秦嶺西麓的仇池楊氏。仇池為略陽清水氐人所建，前仇池自西晉元康六年（296）楊茂搜率部落四千家遷入仇池、稱仇池公起，歷經前秦攻滅與前秦崩潰後重建，後仇池以仇池城為中心，領武都、陰平二郡，後來勢力延伸至漢中、祁山一帶，漢中正是它伸入關中與巴蜀的觸角。氐人政權的指揮系統仍帶部族色彩，楊氏世襲仇池公，控制著谷道沿線的堡壘與部曲歸附。第三方是劉宋：元嘉七年（430）益州刺史劉道真乘仇池內訌攻入仇池，仇池公楊難當出降，漢中郡隨即歸入益州方向的防守；同期巴蜀與宋在益州邊境相持，漢中一帶正處在三方夾縫之中。
countriesEn: The two sides were Northern Wei and the Di-ruled Chouchi regime in the Qinling uplands. Northern Wei, ruled from Pingcheng by Emperor Taiwu Tuoba Tao, was in 433 still consolidating the Hexi Corridor, with the state councilor Cui Hao handling strategy, the princes including Tuoba Huang holding the western front at Liangzhou, and the Tuoba cavalry remaining the backbone of the army, Han Chinese generals and the old Xianbei, Jie and Di contingents sharing out the commands; toward the west the court kept the Tuyuhun close through hostages, gifts and the formal appointment of their chiefs. The other side was the Chouchi state of the Yang clan, a Di polity founded by the Yang family of Lueyang in the Qingshui valley. The earlier Chouchi was founded in 296, when Yang Maosou led four thousand households to the new site and took the title Duke of Chouchi; it fell to Former Qin in 371 and was rebuilt after that regime collapsed, the later Chouchi keeping Chouchi city as its seat, holding the two commanderies of Wudu and Yinping, and eventually stretching its influence to Hanzhong and Mount Qi, Hanzhong being the feeler it pushed into Guanzhong and Bashu. A people-based command structure survived under the Yang house, which inherited the title Duke of Chouchi and held the forts and the feudatory bands along the valley roads. A third party stood in the background: in the seventh year of Yuanjia (430) the governor of Yizhou, Liu Daozhen, exploited a succession dispute inside Chouchi, stormed the city and received the surrender of Yang Nandang; Hanzhong commandery then passed into the Yizhou defensive system, while Sichuan and Song wore each other down along the Yizhou border, leaving Hanzhong suspended in the gap between three powers.
people: 關鍵人物可分三組。其一是北魏一方：主拓跋燾、參贊軍務的尚書令崔浩，以及坐鎮河西的諸王拓跋晃；赫連夏末主赫連定在關中失守後西走隴西，投奔吐谷渾，終被吐谷渾擒獲送京師，京師一度議其刑罰，崔浩力主不可姑息、當明正典刑，太武帝最終將其誅於平城。其二是仇池楊氏：孝昭王楊玄死後，諸子楊保宗與楊難當相爭，保宗奔魏，被封武都王；難當早年為劉宋所擒，羈留建康，其後重返漢中、祁山，在436年前後自稱大秦王，440年復稱武都王，至442年前後死去，其子楊保熾嗣位，443年後仇池為北魏所滅。其三是劉宋方面的益州刺史劉道真，他於元嘉七年驅走仇池守軍、迎難當降宋。關於漢中一線在433年前後的具體交鋒，史料僅存零星記載，諸說並存，具體的指揮者、佈陣與行軍路線多不可考。
peopleEn: Three groups of men matter here. First, the Wei side: the emperor Tuoba Tao, the state councilor Cui Hao who shaped strategy, and the princes such as Tuoba Huang who held Liangzhou. The last ruler of the Xia state of Helian, Helian Ding, lost his position in Guanzhong and fled west to Longxi; caught by the Tuyuhun, he was handed over to the Wei capital at Pingcheng, where his sentence was debated, Cui Hao pressing that he should not be let off but be made to answer fully for his crimes, and the emperor finally had him executed at Pingcheng. Second, the Yang house of Chouchi: after the death of the Xiaozhao King Yang Xuan, his sons Yang Baozong and Yang Nandang fought over the succession; Baozong fled to Wei and was made King of Wudu, while Nandang, who had earlier been captured by Song and kept at Jiankang, later returned to Hanzhong and Mount Qi, proclaimed himself King of Great Qin around 436, reverted to the title King of Wudu in 440, and died around 442; his son Yang Baozhi succeeded him, and in 443 Chouchi was destroyed by Northern Wei. Third, on the Song side, the governor of Yizhou Liu Daozhen, who broke the Chouchi defence in 430 and escorted Nandang into submission. The detailed course of the fighting around Hanzhong in and around 433 survives only in scattered notices, several readings compete, and the actual commanders, deployments and marches cannot be reconstructed with confidence.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是希臘重步兵（hoplite）——公元前五世紀希臘城邦的重裝步兵：方陣的重心不是個人，而是互相遮蔽；盾牌接在一起時，一支軍隊的正面比一個人結實。必須說清楚，這支希臘方陣從未出現在秦嶺的谷道上，433年的漢中戰線上沒有希臘人，也沒有重裝方陣這樣的兵種。卡上取的是「重裝步兵」這一譜系本身：圓盾（hoplon）、青銅胸甲、青銅頭盔、長矛（sarissa 一系的 dory）、短劍與脛甲，重量集中在軀幹正面。回到實際戰場，北魏與仇池雙方真正依賴的是騎兵與山地步兵。北魏以控弦騎兵為主力，配札甲、環首直刃刀、雙刃矛與長槊，攻城則用投石、撞車、雲梯與火箭；守城一方靠單兵弩機、弓矢、礌石、落木與滾石封住谷道與城頭，糧秣靠牛車、驢馬沿漢水、沮水與隴右的小路分段運送，因為秦嶺棧道與谷道承受不了大隊車馬，有些路段只能靠人力背運。對照之下，希臘重步兵最值得借鑑的不是青銅，而是那面盾：以盾遮蔽、互相掩護的密集步兵線，正是隘道與城垣前最難啃的形制；當然，433年的漢中並沒有那種整齊的方陣，只有山民、屯戶與邊軍拼湊起來的散兵線。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Greek hoplite, a heavy infantryman of the Greek city-states of the fifth century BC, whose phalanx works because the centre of strength is not the individual but mutual cover, and a wall of shields is far stronger than a single man. It has to be said plainly that no Greek phalanx ever fought in the Qinling valleys, that there were no Hellenes at Hanzhong in 433, and that a close-order heavy infantry arm was not a feature of that war. What the card takes from the hoplite is the heavy-infantry lineage itself: the round shield (hoplon), the bronze cuirass, the bronze helmet, the long spear (the dory of the sarissa family), the short sword and the greaves, with the weight concentrated on the frontal aspect of the body. In the field of 433 the real reliance of both sides lay in cavalry and mountain infantry. Wei's main strength was its mounted archers, equipped with lamellar armour, ring-pommel straight-slicing sabres, double-edged spears and long pikes, and it brought stone-throwers, battering rams, siege ladders and incendiary arrows against fortifications. The defenders answered with single-man crossbows, bows, sling-stones, felled timber and rolling rocks that sealed the valley tracks and the wall-heads, and the grain moved by ox-cart, mule and donkey along the Han, Ju and Longxi tracks in short stages, because the Qinling plank roads and narrow valleys could not take heavy trains and in places everything had to be carried on men's backs. Against that background the hoplite's real lesson is not its bronze but its shield: a dense line of infantry that covers itself and its neighbour is exactly the formation that a gorge approach or a wall face makes hardest to break, and in Hanzhong in 433 there was no such ordered phalanx, only a ragged line patched together from hill folk, garrison households and frontier soldiers.
tactics: 漢中一線的戰術條件，先由地形決定。從關中入漢中，可走斜谷、褒斜、儻駱、子午諸道；從漢中往隴右有陰平一線，蜀地北上則靠白水江谷與劍閣棧道。這些道路多為狹谷棧道，寬處不過容數騎並行，車輛多賴人力轉運，遇雨則路斷糧停。北魏的慣用辦法是沿河谷快速推進騎兵，以輕騎切斷對手的糧道與遊騎通路，再以步兵與器械攻堅城邑；仇池則依山險築壘，扼守住谷道、斷糧、襲擾糧運，避開魏騎兵的正面衝鋒，同時用落石、滾木、弩矢封閉隘口，等待宋、蜀方向的援軍或時局變化。433年赫連定西走隴西時，吐谷渾的游騎在山地追逐並斷其糧道，扮演了追擊者的角色，與北魏形成南北相持的態勢。同時期巴蜀與劉宋在益州邊境拉鋸，漢中因此成為三面受觀望的真空地帶，誰先打通谷道、誰能保住糧道，誰就決定這一地區的歸屬。
tacticsEn: The tactics in the Hanzhong theatre were dictated first by the ground. From Guanzhong one entered Hanzhong by the Xie, Baoxie, Tangluo and Ziwu tracks; from Hanzhong to Longxi ran the Yinping road, while the route north from Sichuan climbed the Bailing River valley and the Jiange plank road. Most of these were narrow gorges, barely wide enough for a few horsemen abreast, with carts moved by human labour and the tracks cut after rain. Wei's habit was to push cavalry fast along the river valleys, send light horse to cut the enemy's supply line and roaming tracks, and then bring up infantry and engines to take the walled towns; Chouchi, for its part, relied on the fastness of the hills, raised stockades across the tracks, cut supplies, raided the convoys and avoided meeting the Wei horse head-on, at the same time sealing the passes with rock, timber and crossbow bolts in the hope of Song or Sichuan relief, or of a change in the general situation. When Helian Ding fled west to Longxi in 433, Tuyuhun light horse pursued him through the hills and cut his supplies, so that the pursuit came from the south while Wei pressed from the north. Sichuan and Song were meanwhile grinding against each other along the Yizhou frontier, which left Hanzhong a vacuum watched from three sides; whoever opened the valley road first and kept his supply line alive decided the issue.
data: 可核對的數字有限，以下幾項有據：前仇池建於西晉元康六年（296），楊茂搜率部落四千家遷入仇池，自稱輔國將軍、右賢王；後仇池領武都、陰平二郡，勢力一度延伸到漢中與祁山。劉宋元嘉七年（430）益州刺史劉道真破仇池，仇池公楊難當出降；元嘉十年（433）赫連夏主赫連定出長安而西走隴西，為吐谷渾所擒，送魏都平城誅之；漢中方面，楊難當在436年前後自稱大秦王，440年復稱武都王，442年前後去世，子楊保熾嗣位，443年後仇池為北魏所滅，仇池國的歷史至此結束。雙方兵員、攻城器械數目、陣亡與俘虜數，《魏書》《宋書》均未留下可核的記載，諸說並存，因此不宜寫成確數；秦嶺谷道的里程與糧秣消耗亦無從估算，本段只列有年份與地望可以對應的數字。
dataEn: The verifiable figures are few, and the following are attested. The earlier Chouchi was founded in the sixth year of Yuankang (296), when Yang Maosou moved four thousand households to Chouchi and styled himself Assistant to the State and Right Worthy King; the later Chouchi held the two commanderies of Wudu and Yinping, and its reach at times extended to Hanzhong and Mount Qi. In the seventh year of Yuanjia (430) Liu Daozhen, governor of Yizhou, broke Chouchi and received the surrender of Yang Nandang. In the tenth year of Yuanjia (433) the Xia ruler Helian Ding left Chang'an and went west into Longxi, was taken by the Tuyuhun and handed over to the Wei capital at Pingcheng, where he was executed. On the Chouchi side, Yang Nandang proclaimed himself King of Great Qin around 436, reverted to King of Wudu in 440, died around 442, was succeeded by his son Yang Baozhi, and in 443 the state of Chouchi was destroyed by Northern Wei, bringing the Chouchi polity to its end. Troop strengths, the number of siege engines, casualties and prisoners are simply not recorded in a checkable form in the Wei Shu or the Song Shu, competing accounts exist, and none can safely be quoted as a precise figure; nor can the mileage of the Qinling tracks or the grain consumption be reconstructed. Only the dated and place-attached items are listed here.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。最外層是赫連夏的崩解：夏主赫連定在關中站不住腳，西走隴西，捲入秦嶺與隴右的權力真空，隴西一度成為北魏西境眼前的威脅，也讓原本獨立的仇池得以喘息。第二層是仇池楊氏自身的擴張：氐人政權要在漢中、祁山站穩腳跟，必須控制關中通往巴蜀與南方的谷道，而北魏一旦完成河西整合，就會沿著同一條谷道向東壓過來，兩者的邊界在漢中、陰平一帶直接相接，難以長期並存。第三層是劉宋造成的變數：宋先取仇池，把楊難當羈留建康，漢中郡一度歸入益州防區，宋、蜀兩家在益州邊境互相消耗，誰都騰不出手收拾漢中。正因三方在漢中互相牽制，433年之後這裡沒有一次可以一決勝負的會戰，而是長達十年以上的反覆拉鋸：北魏要的是把隴右、漢中連成一條完整的邊防線，仇池要的是守住自己的立國之地，劉宋與蜀則在益州方向勉力自保。
causeEn: There were three layers of reason behind the fighting. The outermost was the collapse of the Xia state of Helian: with his position in Guanzhong gone, Helian Ding went west to Longxi and was drawn into the power vacuum between the Qinling range and Longxi, and Longxi for a time became a threat to the Wei western frontier while giving the independent Chouchi regime room to breathe. The second layer was the expansionism of the Yang house of Chouchi. For the Di polity to hold Hanzhong and Mount Qi it had to control the valley roads linking Guanzhong with Bashu and the south, and once Wei finished integrating Hexi it would press east along those same roads; the borders of the two powers met directly around Hanzhong and Yinping and could not long coexist. The third layer was the disruption caused by Liu Song. Song struck Chouchi first, kept Yang Nandang at Jiankang, and drew Hanzhong commandery into the Yizhou defence system, while Song and Sichuan wore each other down along the Yizhou border and neither could spare the men to settle Hanzhong. Because all three powers held one another in check at Hanzhong, there was no single decisive engagement after 433; instead the region saw a tug of war lasting more than a decade. Wei wanted the Longxi-Hanzhong line sealed into one continuous frontier, Chouchi wanted to keep the ground on which its state had been raised, and Song and Sichuan could only hold their own positions in Yizhou.
impact: 影響是漸進的。赫連定的死與關中歸於北魏，使北魏的西部邊界從平城、涼州一路推到秦嶺東麓，關中、隴右與河西第一次被同一套軍事秩序連起來；北魏得以在涼州、敦煌一線設郡置縣、以羈縻方式安頓吐谷渾與河西諸部，把原來游離在兩大政權之外的西域通道納入版圖。對仇池楊氏而言，生存空間被一步步壓縮：漢中與祁山成了前沿，443年北魏攻滅仇池、徙其民，氐人政權在隴右最後的立足點消失，部眾被遷往關中與關東，此後仇池故地只剩流散部落與零星渠帥留下的痕跡。對蜀地與劉宋而言，漢中屏障尚在，卻已不再可靠；魏軍一旦順利控制谷道，漢中就變成插入巴蜀背後的楔子，此後魏軍南下漢中、益州時便有了現成的通道與基地。這條通道的價值，要到數百年後的分裂末期才完全顯現。
impactEn: The consequences were cumulative. The death of Helian Ding and the reduction of Guanzhong under Wei pushed the western frontier of the empire from Pingcheng and Liangzhou right up to the eastern foot of the Qinling, and for the first time Guanzhong, Longxi and Hexi were tied into a single military order. Wei could set up commanderies and counties through Liangzhou and Dunhuang and settle the Tuyuhun and the peoples of Hexi under a system of loose control, drawing the western routes that had previously floated free between the two great powers into its orbit. For the Yang house of Chouchi the living space contracted step by step: Hanzhong and Mount Qi became the front line, and in 443 Wei destroyed Chouchi and moved its people away, so that the last Di foothold in Longxi disappeared and the old Chouchi lands were left only with scattered bands and the traces of a few local commanders. For Sichuan and for Song the barrier of Hanzhong still stood, but it was no longer reliable; once Wei held the valley roads, Hanzhong became a wedge driven into the rear of Bashu, and the road and the base it offered were still there when Wei campaigned south into Hanzhong and Yizhou many centuries later.
result: 433年的漢中沒有決戰結局，這本身就是結果。赫連定被吐谷渾擒送平城誅殺，關中與隴右的門戶向魏軍敞開；吐谷渾與北魏結盟，西域與河西的交通線換了主人；仇池楊氏並未被消滅，反而在漢中、祁山又撐了十年，436年自稱大秦王與魏軍相抗，兵敗後440年復稱武都王，再度受制於魏，442年前後楊難當死、其子楊保熾嗣位，443年北魏出兵攻破仇池城，仇池國滅，楊氏宗族被徙，漢中與祁山盡入北魏。劉宋在益州方向的邊防因此更形緊張，蜀地在劫後獲得喘息。史家多以「漢中之戰」概括433年前後秦嶺一線的攻防，但具體的戰鬥經過、雙方將領姓名與兵力數目諸說並存，很難逐一核實；能確定的只有大方向：北魏憑騎兵與穀道補給步步逼近，仇池以山險與游擊抵抗，最終在443年被徹底解決。
resultEn: There was no decisive conclusion at Hanzhong in 433, and that absence is itself the result. Helian Ding was taken by the Tuyuhun, handed over to Pingcheng and executed, and the gates of Guanzhong and Longxi stood open to the Wei armies. The Tuyuhun entered into alliance with Wei, and the road to the western regions and to Hexi changed hands. The Yang house of Chouchi was not wiped out: it held on at Hanzhong and Mount Qi for another ten years, proclaimed a King of Great Qin in 436 and fought Wei, reverted to King of Wudu in 440 after defeat, and came under Wei control once more. Yang Nandang died around 442, his son Yang Baozhi succeeded him, and in 443 Wei stormed Chouchi city; the state was destroyed, the Yang clan was moved away, and Hanzhong and Mount Qi passed to Wei. The Song frontier in Yizhou grew more tense in consequence, while Sichuan recovered a little breathing space. Historians generally use the name Battle of Hanzhong for the fighting along the Qinling line around 433, but the course of the individual engagements, the names of the commanders on both sides and the numbers involved are contested and cannot be verified one by one. What can be fixed is the general direction: Wei advanced step by step on the strength of its cavalry and its grain road, Chouchi resisted with the fastness of the hills and with harassment, and the matter was settled completely in 443.
